;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2020 Forbury Gardens stabbings]]
**The fatal [[mass stabbing]] yesterday at [[Forbury Gardens]] in [[Reading, Berkshire|Reading, United Kingdom]], is declared by the [[Thames Valley Police|police]] to have been a [[terrorism in the United Kingdom|terrorist]] attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-berkshire-53127095 (BBC News)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**Forces of the [[Southern Transitional Council]] (STC) seize control of the island of [[Socotra]]. [[President of Yemen|President]] [[Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi]] condemns it as a "full-fledged" [[Coup d'état|coup]], while the governor of the island condemns the [[United Arab Emirates]] and [[Saudi Arabia]] for "turning a blind eye". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-separatists/yemen-separatists-seize-remote-socotra-island-from-saudi-backed-government-idUSKBN23S0DU?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Afghan peace process]]
**The Afghan [[government of Afghanistan|government]] accuses the [[Taliban]] of [[kidnapping]] about 60 civilians in the last week in the [[provinces of Afghanistan|province]] of [[Daykundi Province|Daykundi]]. The Taliban deny the accusation and blames the government for civilian casualties during the past week. At least 26 women and children have been freed and elder tribal leaders are mediating for the release of the rest of abductees. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-taliban/afghan-taliban-kidnap-dozens-of-civilians-amid-peace-efforts-officials-say-idUSKBN23S0GZ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Two bombs explode in front of a [[Somali Armed Forces|military]] official's house in [[Wanlaweyn]], killing four people. In another attack, in [[Galmudug]], three men drove a car packed with bombs against a [[security checkpoint|checkpoint]] after ignoring orders to stop, killing three soldiers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/somalia-killed-bomb-attacks-200621112115099.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[Egypt–Libya relations]]
**The [[Government of National Accord]]'s [[Presidential Council (Libya)|Presidential Council]] says [[President of Egypt|Egyptian president]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]]'s threats to take military action in [[Libya]] constitutes "a declaration of war" on the country. [https://www.libyaobserver.ly/news/presidential-council-says-sisis-threats-are-declaration-war-libya (''The Libya Observer'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
***The [[state of emergency]] in [[Spain]] officially finishes after more than 100 days. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jun/20/spain-pm-urges-people-not-lower-guard-as-state-of-emergency-ends (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Brazil)|Ministry of Health]] reports 641 more deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], bringing the death toll in the country to over 50,000. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-53132225 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020]]
**One person is killed while eleven others are injured during a [[mass shooting]] in [[Minneapolis]], [[Minnesota]]. The incident involved people shooting at one another. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/06/21/us/minneapolis-shooting.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Serbian parliamentary election]] 
**[[Elections in Serbia|Parliamentary elections]] are held in [[Serbia]] roughly one month after the measures to fight the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia|COVID-19 pandemic]] were lifted. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-serbia-election/serbians-head-to-polls-in-europes-first-post-lockdown-election-idUSKBN23S001 (Reuters)]
